explanation: The initial implementation was a simple single-beat FIFO without packet framing (start/end of packet). The verification testbench expects multi-beat packet frames (each frame has multiple bytes with associated user/dest/id). The new design implements a packet FIFO with start-of-packet (sop) and end-of-packet (eop) signals, storing user/dest/id per beat. The FIFO depth is increased to 32 beats to accommodate the testbench's 24-beat transfer. The interface matches the expected AXIS-like packet interface with tdata, tuser, tdest, tid, tsop, teop, tvalid, tready.
